title: The Phase 6 per-user loss bound (ERC4626_MAX_LOSS_BPS = 2) sits inside autoDOLA's stepwise live spread, so :preview's go/no-go flips between blocks. The bound is enforced only in forge's local pass, so a regime step during the Ledger session lands a migration above 2 bps that only :verify's live-balance aggregate detects

description: ERC4626_MAX_LOSS_BPS = 2 (script L147-154) is the per-user loss bound on the ERC4626 strategies, and its NatSpec justifies it as ~2.3x the worst observed autopool round trip. On a mainnet fork the live autoDOLA round-trip spread is stepwise: at block 25985945 (story 087 block) every one of 9 DOLA users breaches the bound (2.069-2.093 bps; preview run() reverts with the exact bound revert), while at 25988932 all 9 pass (0.948-0.959 bps) and the full preview passes all 9 stages. The bound is evaluated only in forge's local pass; the landed Phase 6 transactions do not re-check it on chain. A regime step during the ~30-tx Ledger session therefore lands a migration above 2 bps. Resume-shape and :verify per-user checks pass on that landed state; only :verify's live per-pool aggregate reverts (short 0.008936 DOLA on fork), and ~0.009 DOLA of organic V2 stake would mask it. Story 087's Concerns claim that the verifier's per-user credit check bounds the total is false: it covers only the re-deposit leg.
impact: Go/no-go for :preview flips between blocks (red for ~22.5h in the observed high-spread regime) without any code change; fail-closed before any tx. If the step happens mid-session, stakers are charged a round trip above the stated 2 bps bound (at current size ~0.26 DOLA total, ~0.009 DOLA over spec) and the only on-chain-landing detector is a maskable aggregate. Proportional in bps, so re-weigh if pool TVL grows materially before broadcast.
attackPath: 1. Operator runs :preview / forge local pass while autoDOLA is in a low-spread regime (<2 bps round trip) - all requires pass.
2. During the ~30-tx Ledger signing session, autoDOLA steps to its high-spread regime (observed 2.07-2.09 bps round trip, lasting ~22.5h).
3. Phase 6 transactions land on chain; the per-user require is not re-evaluated on chain, so the migration completes above 2 bps.
4. Resume/preview re-run and :verify per-user checks pass; only :verify's live per-pool aggregate reverts (short 0.008936 DOLA on fork), and it can be masked by ~0.009 DOLA of organic V2 stake.

classification.assetImpact: Staker principal in the DOLA (and in principle USDC) pool: an over-bound migration charges the live autopool round-trip spread to stakers. At current size ~2.09 bps of ~1,222.7 DOLA (~0.26 DOLA) total, of which the portion above the stated 2 bps spec is ~0.009 DOLA (<$1). The spread charge itself is socialized-by-design (F-02 wont-fix); only the over-spec residual and the lost gate guarantee are defects.

classification.likelihood: low - requires an autopool regime step inside a single signing session; steps are discrete and observed hours-to-days apart
classification.assumptions: Cutover not yet broadcast; pool sizes as of block 25988932; autopool spread regimes as observed across 25981150-25988932
classification.externalRequirements: Tokemak autoDOLA/autoUSDC state-driven spread step between local pass and on-chain inclusion; operator broadcasting in that window
classification.availability: Go/no-go red for ~22.5h without code change. Fail-closed before any tx: V1 continues to operate, no funds locked, retry-able on regime change or after re-calibration. This is delay of a one-shot owner migration, not impairment of live protocol function. A stale progress file after a local-pass revert (by inspection, not executed) needs manual trimming - operational friction, not a brick.

severityRationale: Medium requires either impaired protocol function/availability or a value leak with a stated attack path. Neither clears the bar: (a) the 22.5h red go/no-go blocks only an owner-initiated, not-yet-broadcast migration while the live V1 system keeps serving users, fails closed with zero transactions, and is retry-able - this is operational delay, not protocol availability loss; (b) the value path is dust (~0.009 DOLA over spec, ~0.26 DOLA total round-trip spread which is by-design socialized loss), needs an exogenous regime step inside a single signing session, and is still detected (not silently accepted) by :verify's aggregate. It is not downgraded to QA because it is fork-proven, the NatSpec rationale for the constant is empirically false, the only on-chain-landing detector is maskable, and a competent owner would be surprised that a green local pass bounds nothing about the landed Phase 6 txs (Law 3 footgun). Low.
recommendation: 1) Re-derive ERC4626_MAX_LOSS_BPS in its own story from a multi-day sample of autoDOLA/autoUSDC previewRedeem/previewDeposit versus convertToAssets covering at least one up-step (observed max 2.07 bps round trip), e.g. 2x observed max (~5 bps); rewrite the L147-153 NatSpec to cite that sample. 2) In `_initiatePool`, for ERC4626 pools, pre-quote the round trip before `initiateMigration` (as already done for the market strategy): exit = previewRedeem(convertToShares(P)), re-deposit = convertToAssets(previewDeposit(credit)); log `LOSS_HEADROOM|token|bps` in preview and STOP AND REPORT when it exceeds the bound. 3) Runbook (//:broadcast): state that the Phase 6 bound depends on the autopool regime, that :preview must be re-run immediately before signing, that a :verify aggregate red right after a green local pass means the regime moved mid-session (resume will not detect it), and what to do with a progress file left by a local-pass revert (delete it when no transaction was sent). 4) Correct story 087's Concerns claim about the verifier's per-user check bounding the total, or add a per-user total (pre -> credited) check to the verifier, reconstructing pre-migration principal from the MigratedOut credit as credit*P/min(R,P).
